name: playbook_check
label: 话术命中检测
description: Sales-script hit check: match what the salesperson actually said in the transcripts against the standard scripts using both literal and semantic matching (all categories by default, pass category to filter), and return the matched lines, the match method and the script coverage rate.

days.description: time window in days (last N days)

limit.description: maximum number of conversations to check

category.description: script-library category keyword (empty = match all categories)
